title: The Wound Beyond the World
description: The catastrophe around the old Tower did more than ruin land. It scarred the boundaries between realms and left a dimensional Wasteland behind. That wound still exists. Reach it, Sire. Whatever waits there has had centuries too long to imagine itself beyond your reach.
description_completed: The Overlord has entered the dimensional Wasteland represented by Minecraft's End. The central campaign is now armed for its final mechanical resolution without imposing any civilization or Tower-completion checklist.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record entry into the dimensional Wasteland
